Looking through the paper text, I can find references to glass compositions. The paper mentions compositions like "Na3S10", "Na3S4", and "Na La4" as sample identifiers for soda silicate glasses with lanthanum. The paper references "paper I" for the full composition table (Table 1), but within this text, the compositions are described in terms of La concentration (e.g., 1-10 mol% La in soda silicate glasses) and a specific mention of ~0.2 mol% La for the two-La-ion simulation.
